entities.summary: Henrik Vibskov is a Danish fashion designer, artist, curator and musician. Commonly associated with the fashion brand carrying the same name, his work is known for its enticing universes and crossover into other art forms. Working in the intersection between art and design, his work includes: art, installations, scenography, costumes, video, performance and exhibitions. Henrik Vibskov was a composers & musicians from Kjellerup (b. 1972-10-05, Kjellerup). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
